title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Fe Downs on 1983-09-11
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Clear matrix recording captures a jam‑heavy show highlighted by Let It Grow → Drums and an extended Wang Dang Doodle.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear matrix source that blends the original feeds into a very open sound. The performance shines with a jammy Let It Grow flowing into Drums and a long, improvisational Wang Dang Doodle, despite Bob’s vocal mic being out of commission. Overall it’s an excellent listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and praise both the musical performance and the matrix sound quality; limited to two reviews, confidence is medium but rating remains high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blend described as very clear and open; combines multiple sources for best result. No major audio flaws noted, though Bob's vocal mic was down during the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy flow with Let It Grow segued into Drums and a lengthy Wang Dang Doodle, giving the second set an especially improvisational feel.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob's vocal mic wasn't working during the performance.
